ablation.name: sem_r8_spectral_mechanism
ablation.notes: Mechanism 5: Spectral-decoupled region SWD. DWT-decompose gen/target: LL (low-freq) gets GLOBAL SWD (preserve structure), LH/HL/HH (high-freq) get REGION SWD (match texture per content region). Tests if frequency-band division beats single-K spatial region. hf_weight=2.0 up-weights texture matching (MUSIQ driver).
